name: East Tennessee Murray Project
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row: roster has East Tennessee Gas Pipeline P0179 (main line), P5627 (Ridgeline) and P7809 (System Alignment, 23 mi, NC), none is the Murray lateral. Two independent sources. A Federal Register notice from February 15, 2001 (docket CP01-80-000) says East Tennessee Natural Gas proposed about 27 miles of 20-inch pipeline extending Line 3500 through Hamilton County, Tennessee and Catoosa, Whitfield and Murray Counties, Georgia, at an estimated cost of $69,390,000, to serve Dalton, Cartersville and the 1,240 MW Murray power plant (up to 165,000 Dth/d). The EIA pipeline projects workbook for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 249, lists ETenn Murray Project as completed September 2002, 27 mi, 20 in, 160 MMcf/d added capacity, cost 69.39 million, docket CP01-80. The FERC approved major pipeline projects page lists the project too. Sits in expansion shape under the parent system name. Length 27 mi is about 43 km, above the 25 km threshold. Federal Register text was checked for length, diameter, cost, counties; EIA for status, date, capacity. EIA capacity of 160 MMcf/d is incremental for the project. Owner not staged: the parent system is recorded with Enbridge in the sheet (P0179) but no ref was verified for current ownership; apply the P0179 owner on review. Cost is 2001 estimate. Route not found; no official GIS located, so staged as no route. Exact start and end points beyond county level were not found.
